title: An integer multiplicity current represented off the origin by an oriented, locally H^m-finite set is represented everywhere (parent steps 8–9, B10b)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1, C ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ m) integer multiplicity, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel with 0 ∉ M, and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) continuous on M. Assume |⟨α, ξ(x)⟩| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for x ∈ M and every m-covector α, and H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K (H^m = μHE[m]). Assume also C(ω) = ∫_M ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^m(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with 0 ∉ tsupport ω. Then C(ω) = ∫_M ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^m(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), 1 ≤ m → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → MeasurableSet M → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → ContinuousOn ξ M → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (0 : Euclid P) ∉ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) → C ω = ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, C ω = ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]
